role: independent non-author replication; no gate verdict, no node transition, no validation_status=passed
question: Do the headline 'measured universe' numbers of worker-075's source-meta census (source_meta_census_075.json, sha256 b816178b94f7...) reproduce under an independently written implementation at the same pinned bytes, and is '201 citations' the size of any single canonical citation universe?

target_under_test.author: worker-075
target_under_test.note: The target's README definitions and its own recorded numbers are inputs; the target's census_source_meta_075.py is deliberately NOT read before this worker's implementation is written.

pinned_snapshot.source: the 43 paths and per-file sha256 recorded in source_meta_census_075.json:input_files
pinned_snapshot.drift_rule: Re-hash every input immediately before and after measurement. Any mismatch with the recorded sha256 aborts with exit 2 and writes no report body.

definitions_pre_registered.source_record: any of (source_id|citation_id|bibkey|id) present AND title present AND any of (doi|arxiv_id|url) present
definitions_pre_registered.source_unique_key: first non-empty of [source_id, citation_id, bibkey, id, key]; fallback 'title|year' normalized
definitions_pre_registered.class_row: row_id present AND source_id present AND (class_id or class_ids or class_mapping) present
definitions_pre_registered.axis_present: literal axis key among [matter_model, cosmological_constant, dimension, symmetry, formulation] at top level (depth 0) or in a nested dict at depth <= 2
definitions_pre_registered.citation_link: (theorem_id, source_id) derived from each theorem record's source_ids/source_id entries
definitions_pre_registered.near_miss: a key matching (?i)(matter|lambda|cosmolog|dimension|dim|symmetr|formulation|scope|model) that is not one of the five axes

comparisons_pre_registered: per-axis coverage = 0 for all five axes in all seven universes
per-class raw source counts AF-SCC-C0-VAC-GEN 67, AF-SCC-C2-VAC-GEN 58, AF-WCC-VAC-GEN 26, AF-WCC-SCALAR-SPH 18, no-token 337
201 is not equal to any measured universe
named decomposition A: registry.jsonl 97 + citation_audit.csv 97 + w07-sources.jsonl 7 = 201 with 104 distinct ids
named decomposition B: registry.jsonl 97 + theorems.jsonl 62 + unresolved.jsonl 12 + w07-theorems.jsonl 15 + citation_audit_wcc_flash-08.jsonl 15 = 201 with 189 distinct ids
no canonical single file has exactly 201 rows

controls_pre_registered.C4_near_miss_only: {"scope_caveats":["spherical_symmetry"]} does NOT fire an axis but reports a near-miss key
controls_pre_registered.C6_duplicate_source_key: two source records with one shared source_id give raw 2, unique 1
controls_pre_registered.C7_duplicate_link: the same (theorem_id, source_id) twice gives raw 2, unique 1
controls_pre_registered.C8_pin_drift: a tampered copy aborts fail-closed before any report body is written

decision_rule: REPLICATED if every pre-registered comparison matches the target's recorded value and every control passes; PARTIAL if any headline differs under the primary rule and the difference is explained by an explicit alternative rule reading (reported both ways); NOT_REPLICATED if the primary-rule recomputation contradicts a target value with no rule-level explanation.

amendments.change: Control C3 was written as {"a":{"b":{"dimension":4}}} expecting no fire, which contradicts this prereg's own axis_present depth<=2 definition. Renamed: C3 is now the depth-3 case {"a":{"b":{"c":{"dimension":4}}}} (no fire) and C3b is the depth-2 case {"a":{"b":{"dimension":4}}} (fires under the primary depth<=2 reading; does not fire under the strict depth<=1 reading). Both readings are measured and reported for every universe (records_with_any_axis vs records_with_any_axis_strict_depth_le_1, max_axis_hit_depth); the zero-coverage result is reported under both.
amendments.reason: The selftest exposed an expectation/definition mismatch before any census number was computed.

falsifier: Falsified by: (a) any of the 43 inputs re-hashing to a value other than the recorded sha256 at T0 or T1; (b) a deterministic re-run yielding different numbers; (c) any control C1-C8 departing from its pre-registered expectation; (d) a live file that literally carries one of the five axis keys in a record counted as carrying none.
authority_limits: no gate verdict, no node status transition, no validation_status=passed
no write outside artifacts/worker-100/, runtime/state/ and comms/outbox/worker-100.jsonl
census numbers are evidence about documents, not a mathematics or physics claim
